overview.label: Story
overview.heading: Overview
overview.body: Redesigned complex financial workflows through user research and iterative testing — cutting task completion time by 20%. WCAG-accessible dashboards with QR-based expense tracking.

problem.label: Problem
problem.heading: Why this needed to exist
problem.body: Complex financial workflows were slow and inaccessible, increasing errors and task time.

approach.label: Approach
approach.heading: How the work got done
approach.body: Led user research and iterative testing to simplify flows, then rebuilt responsive, WCAG-accessible dashboards with QR-based expense tracking.

outcomes.label: Outcomes
outcomes.heading: What changed once it shipped
outcomes.body: 20% reduction in task completion time and more inclusive access — dashboard adoption grew with tested clarity.

credits.label: Credits
credits.heading: One last thing
credits.body: Designed for Chatoor.ai — Redesigned complex financial workflows through user research and iterative testing — cutting task completion time by 20%. WCAG-accessible dashboards with QR-based expense tracking.
